items.Sentence: Part of Treatment Pond 1 will be converted to an aerated lagoon system with both partially and fully mixed cells separated by baffle curtains.
The remainder of Pond 1, and Ponds 2 and 3 will serve as effluent storage ponds.
Pond 4 will continue to be used as a clear well for the effluent pump station.
The improvements project currently planned (known as Phase I) will consist of increasing the effluent lift station capacity to 0.79 mgd;
To accommodate projected flows for 2016 through 2025, the Wastewater Facilities Plan envisions ... improving the chlorine disinfection system to increase contact time;
The Discharger currently scarifies each P/E pond every three to four years on a rotational basis.
the Discharger states that it may be possible to increase the frequency of scarification to once every two years on average.
